info.name: User and Access Management Identity Providers API
Returns a list of identity providers.

params.name: key
params.description: Unique identifier of the identity provider.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Pattern to be searched in provider name.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

items.docs:
Returns a list of identity providers for the given conditions/filters. Use query parameters to filter the result based on different criteria.

API client must have at least one permission.

Returns the identity provider by key.

API client must have at least one permission.
